main.description: Operator-only, idempotent upsert of a role: a stable name that senders address and the issuer resolves to its target row at accept time. A name that is bound, reserved or retired is refused with NameCollision, except a self-role (name equals target), which labels an existing row or reserved name as a role without redirecting it. The target must be a bound name, or a reserved name for a self-role.

errors.name: NameCollision
errors.description: The name is already bound, reserved or retired, and it is not a self-role.

errors.name: UnknownName
errors.description: The target is not a bound name.
